Specification: This module defines a small TLA+ specification centered on a single variable x and a helper operator FApply that folds a binary operator over the values of a function's domain. The recursive behavior is encoded through a LET-bound operator fa indexed by subsets of DOMAIN f, using CHOOSE to select an element of a nonempty subset and combining values with the supplied operator and identity element. The specification initializes x to 1 and additionally checks, via TLC's Print and Assert operators, that applying multiplication over the function [i \in {"a", "b", "c"} |-> 3] with identity 1 yields 27; the only step action stutters x by setting x' = x, and the module includes trivial invariant and constraint predicates TRUE.
IfThenElse: IF S = { } THEN Identity ELSE LET s == CHOOSE s \in S : TRUE IN f[s] ++ fa[S \ {s}]
IF FApply([i \in {"a", "b", "c"} |-> 3], *, 1) = 27 THEN Print("Test 1 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 1 Failed")
